children: Collector Crypt has executed an on-chain burn of 22,485,689 CARDS, equal to about 5.4% of circulating supply. The tokens were acquired through USDC buybacks, support buys, and liquidity pool fees before being permanently removed from circulation. The completed transaction provides an on-chain record of the burn.

The reduction changes the number of CARDS available in circulation without relying on an announced future schedule. Because the burned tokens were acquired with USDC through buybacks, support buys, and liquidity pool fees, the event connects the supply change to those stated funding sources.
The confirmed transaction establishes the completed burn and its reported size. It does not establish how future supply, demand, or market valuation will develop.

title: Collector Crypt: CARDS burn executes on-chain - 29 Aug 2026
